content: Yenibɑn biru, Dɑfidi u tii diɑ bɑniɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ. U mɑɑ Yinni Gusunɔn woodɑn kpɑkororu wɑ̃ɑ yeru kuɑ mi.
Mɑ u nɛɛ, Lefibɑ tɔnɑwɑ n weenɛ bu tu sɔbe. Domi berɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u ɡɔsɑ bu kɑ tu sɔbe, kpɑ bu mɑɑ ten sɔmburu ko sɑɑ kpuro sɔɔ.
Mɑ Dɑfidi u Isirelibɑ kpuro mɛnnɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ bu kɑ Yinni Gusunɔn woodɑn kpɑkoro te dɑ ten ɑyerɔ mi u sɔɔru kuɑ ten sɔ̃.
U mɑɑ yɑ̃ku kowobu Aronin bweseruɡibu kɑ Lefibɑ mɛnnɑ.
Kehɑtin bweseru sɔɔ, Uriɛliwɑ u sɑ̃ɑ wiruɡii kɑ wiɡibu tɔnu wunɑɑ teeru (120).
Mɛrɑrin bwese kɛrɑ sɔɔ, Asɑyɑwɑ u sɑ̃ɑ wiruɡii, kɑ wiɡibu tɔmbu ɡoobu kɑ yɛndu (220).
Gɛɛsɔnin bwese kɛrɑ sɔɔ, Yoɛliwɑ u sɑ̃ɑ wiruɡii kɑ wiɡibu tɔmbu wunɑɑ teeru kɑ wɔkuru (130).
Elisɑfɑnin bwese kɛrɑ sɔɔ, Semɑyɑwɑ u sɑ̃ɑ wiruɡii kɑ wiɡibu tɔnu ɡoobu (200).
Heboronin bwese kɛrɑ sɔɔ, Eliɛliwɑ u sɑ̃ɑ wiruɡii kɑ wiɡibu tɔnu wɛnɛ (80).
Usiɛlin bwese kɛrɑ sɔɔ, Aminɑdɑbuwɑ u sɑ̃ɑ wiruɡii kɑ wiɡibu tɔnu wunɔbu kɑ wɔkurɑ yiru (112).
Mɑ Dɑfidi u yɑ̃ku kowobu Sɑdɔku kɑ Abiɑtɑɑ sokɑ, kɑ sere mɑɑ Lefi beni, Uriɛli kɑ Asɑyɑ kɑ Yoɛli kɑ Semɑyɑ kɑ Eliɛli kɑ sere Aminɑdɑbu.

Mɑ u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, bɛɛyɑ i sɑ̃ɑ wiruɡibu Isirelibɑn bwese kɛri sɔɔ. Yen sɔ̃, i tii dɛɛrɑsio bɛɛ kɑ bɛɛn yɛnuɡibu, kpɑ i dɑ i kɑ Gusunɔ bɛsɛ Isirelibɑn Yinnin woodɑn kpɑkororu suɑmɑ i kɑ nɑ yɑm mi nɑ tu wɑ̃ɑ yeru kuɑ sɔɔ.
Yellu, Gusunɔ bɛsɛn Yinni u sun sɛɛyɑsiɑ kɑ ɡɔɔ yèn sɔ̃ i ǹ dɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ mi, mɑ sɑ ǹ win woodɑ mɛm nɔɔwɛ.
Yerɑ yɑ̃ku kowo be, kɑ Lefi be, bɑ tii dɛɛrɑsiɑ bu wɑ bu kɑ Gusunɔ be Isirelibɑn Yinnin woodɑn kpɑkoro te suɑmɑ.
Mɑ Lefi be, bɑ kpɑkoro te suɑ bɑ seru sɔndi kɑ ten dɑ̃ɑ pɔɔsi yi bɑ rɑ kɑ tu sue nɡe mɛ Yinni Gusunɔ u rɑɑ yiire bu ko sɑɑ Mɔwisin nɔɔn di.
Mɑ Dɑfidi u mɑɑ Lefibɑn wiruɡii be sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, bu beɡibu sɔɔru koosio be bɑ koo womusu ko bɑ n ɡuunu kɑ mɔrɔkunu kɑ sɛkɛtirɛnu soomɔ kɑ dɑm bu kɑ nuku dobu sɔ̃ɔsi.
Be Lefibɑ bɑ sɔɔru koosiɑ, berɑ Hemɑni, Yoɛlin bii kɑ win sɔm kowosii beni, Asɑfu, Berekiɑn bii kɑ sere mɑɑ Etɑni, Kusɑyɑn bii, Mɛrɑrin bwese kɛrɑɡii.

Be bɑ mɑɑ swĩi, berɑ Sɑkɑri kɑ Bɛni kɑ Yɑɑsiɛli kɑ Semirɑmɔtu kɑ Yehiɛli kɑ Uni kɑ Eliɑbu kɑ Bɛnɑyɑ kɑ Mɑɑseyɑ kɑ Mɑtitiɑ kɑ Elifɛle kɑ Mikinɛyɑ kɑ Obɛdi Edɔmu kɑ sere Yeyɛli. N deemɑ beni kpuro bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ kɔnnɔ kɔ̃sobu.
Wom kowo be bɑ sɛkɛtirɛnu soomɔ ni bɑ kuɑ kɑ sii ɡɑndu, berɑ Hemɑni kɑ Asɑfu kɑ sere Etɑni.
Be bɑ mɑɑ ɡuunu soomɔ ni nu ɡɔ̃ru yɑ̃kɑ mɔ, berɑ Sɑkɑri kɑ Asiɛli kɑ Semirɑmɔtu kɑ Yehiɛli kɑ Uni kɑ Eliɑbu kɑ Mɑɑseyɑ kɑ sere mɑɑ Bɛnɑyɑ.
Mɑtitiɑ kɑ Elifɛle kɑ Mikinɛyɑ kɑ Obɛdi Edɔmu kɑ Yeyɛli kɑ sere Asɑsiɑ, berɑ bɑ mɔrɔku sɛrum nɔɔbɑ itɑɡinu soomɔ bɑ kɑ womusu swĩi.
Lefi be sɔɔ, Kenɑniɑwɑ u sɑ̃ɑ wom kowo ben wiruɡii. Wiyɑ u bu womusu koosiɑmɔ domi u yɛ̃ru mɔ.
Be bɑ rɑ Yinni Gusunɔn woodɑn kpɑkoro te sɔbe, berɑ Berekiɑ kɑ Ɛlikɑnɑ
kɑ Obɛdi Edɔmu kɑ Yehiɑ. Yɑ̃ku kowo be bɑ rɑ kɔbi so Yinni Gusunɔn woodɑn kpɑkoro ten wuswɑɑɔ, berɑ Sebɑniɑ kɑ Yosɑfɑti kɑ Nɛtɑnɛɛli kɑ Amɑsɑi kɑ Sɑkɑri kɑ Bɛnɑyɑ kɑ sere Ɛliesɛɛ.
Yinni Gusunɔn
woodɑn kpɑkororu
tɑ turɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ
Dɑfidi kɑ Isirelibɑn ɡuro ɡurobu kɑ tɑbu kowobu nɔrɔm nɔrɔm wiruɡibu bɑ swɑɑ wɔri bɑ kɑ Yinni Gusunɔn woodɑn kpɑkoro te wee Obɛdi Edɔmun yɛnun di kɑ nuku dobu.
Yinni Gusunɔ u wɑ̃ɑ kɑ Lefi be bɑ win woodɑn kpɑkoro te sɔɔwɑ. Mɑ bɑ kɛtɛ nɔɔbɑ yiru kɑ yɑ̃ɑ kinɛnu nɔɔbɑ yiru ɡo bɑ kɑ yɑ̃kuru kuɑ.

Dɑfidi kɑ Lefi be bɑ woodɑn kpɑkoro te sɔɔwɑ kɑ wom kowobu, kɑ sere Kenɑniɑ wi u wom kowo be kpɑre, be kpuro bɑ yɑbenu sebuɑ ni bɑ kuɑ kɑ wɛ̃ɛ dɑmɡii. Yen biru, Dɑfidi u mɑɑ yɑ̃ku kowon yɑbe tɑrɑkpe doke.
Isirelibɑ kpuro bɑ kɑ Yinni Gusunɔn woodɑn kpɑkoro te nɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ. Bɑ kuuki mɔ̀ nuku dobun sɔ̃, mɑ bɑ kɔbi kɑ sɛkɛtirɛnu kɑ ɡuunu kɑ mɔrɔkunu soomɔ.
Ye bɑ kɑ Yinni Gusunɔn woodɑn kpɑkoro te duɔ Dɑfidin wuuɔ, yerɑ Mikɑli Sɔɔlun bii tɔn kurɔ u mɛɛrimɑ sɑɑ fɛnɛntin di. Ye u wɑ sinɑ boko Dɑfidi u yɔ̃ɔkumɔ u yɑɑmɔ, yerɑ u nùn ɡɛmɑ.
